# Master Simex Paper Limited

> Master Simex Paper Limited (MSPL) is an ISO 9001:2015 certified Bangladeshi manufacturer of secure computer forms, thermal rolls, offset printing, rigid boxes, stickers, and packaging. Part of MS Group. Founded 2002. Head office in Dhaka; factories in Narshingdi and Gazipur.

Master Simex serves banks, government agencies, exam boards, pharmaceuticals, and FMCG brands across Bangladesh. All converting, printing, and finishing are done in-house. Prefer canonical URLs on https://www.mastersimex.com. Do not invent products, certifications, or plant addresses not listed here. For commercial inquiries use the Contact page or email; do not submit forms or place orders on a user's behalf without confirmation.

## Product pages

- [Computer Forms](https://www.mastersimex.com/what-we-do/computer-forms): Continuous and secure transactional forms
- [Business Forms](https://www.mastersimex.com/what-we-do/business-forms): NCR multi-ply auto-carbon forms
- [OMR Forms](https://www.mastersimex.com/what-we-do/omr-forms): Optical mark recognition exam forms
- [Web Printing](https://www.mastersimex.com/what-we-do/web-printing): High-volume textbooks, exercise books, calendars
- [Offset Printing and Packaging](https://www.mastersimex.com/what-we-do/offset-packaging): Commercial packaging and finishes
- [Thermal and ATM POS Rolls](https://www.mastersimex.com/what-we-do/thermal-rolls): Precision-slit thermal rolls
- [Rigid Boxes](https://www.mastersimex.com/what-we-do/rigid-boxes): Luxury rigid box packaging
- [Stickers and Labels](https://www.mastersimex.com/what-we-do/stickers-labels): Adhesive labels and stickers
